resolutions.title: Escalate unresolved work at the stage iteration limit to the user
rationale: The same observable condition can be caused by an undersized limit, an ineffective coder model, hallucinating reviewer models, or a combination of these causes.
The deterministic decision model cannot identify the cause from iteration exhaustion alone.
A user must inspect the evidence and explicitly change the future execution policy.
user_view: current stage id, index, iteration count, and configured limit
unmet acceptance criteria and accepted outstanding review/security findings
role, execution-profile, and model-profile references used by each stage iteration
validated artifacts and transition history relevant to the stage

requirements: the grant is a positive bounded integer
the grant applies to the current stage and future activations only
past iteration, activation, and transition history remains immutable
attempt and activation identities are never reused
accepted_user_intents.note: A user-visible budget reset is represented as a new grant or budget epoch, not by rewriting the old iteration counter.

requirements: at least one role binding changes
each value is a reference to an existing trusted model profile
the referenced profiles remain within operator and Launcher capability ceilings
the change applies only to future activations
endpoint, model, and credential values are resolved from the trusted profile and are not embedded in the response
all requirements of both component intents apply atomically

resume_invariants: the wait record and user response are durably recorded before execution resumes
the response must make at least one declared future-policy change
the orchestrator validates the new budget and all profile references before creating a Session
the resumed execution snapshot records the accepted budget and profile bindings
no agent or prompt may apply this user-authority transition
resolutions.remaining_boundary: The default pipeline still needs an explicit choice of resume targets: restart the full stage at coder, restart only its review cycle, or offer both as separate user intents. P01 does not choose among them.

scenarios.title: A one-iteration limit with unfinished work waits for the user
An ineffective coder after all allowed iterations waits for the user
Possibly hallucinated reviewer findings still require user judgment
Mixed coder and reviewer quality cannot be classified deterministically
Granting more iterations preserves all previous history
Changing model profiles affects future activations only
An empty continue response cannot release the wait
Raw provider settings and tokens are not accepted as wait-response data
